description:
Found by the coordinator during the fz-kdt close arc (2026-09-03, ca23b676f), on the owner`s rule that a canonical/rendered Ty string is for display and debugging only.

THE SMELL: the arc`s primary type-verification instrument asserts type ANSWERS by rendering them. types/arrow_match.rs `pinned_verdicts` builds every expectation through `fn render(t, v)` (arrow_match.rs:1140), which formats `Known params=[..] result=..` out of `t.display(p)`; 52 pins in arrow_match.rs and 4 in contract_test.rs compare that string to a literal. drive_test.rs:10657-10658 does the same for a DISPATCH KEY: `assert_eq!(types.display(&partition_inputs[2]), "[a2_e]")`. Also arrow_match.rs:1175/1928/1950/2165.

WHY IT IS WRONG: `Types::display` is NOT injective. fz-go4.34 (closed) recorded that display strings COLLIDE for distinct arrows (closure kind + captures elided), and fz-kdt.183`s build recorded that display collapses `list(t)` and `non_empty_list(t)` -- which is why that ticket`s rung gate had to read a different comparand. So a pin can stay green while the underlying Ty changes, and a pin can go red for a pure rendering change with no semantic movement. The gates that verify fz-kdt.192 and fz-kdt.184 -- both SOUNDNESS tickets -- are therefore weaker than they read, and the fz-kdt.183 frontier gate asserts a specialization key through a lossy channel.

PRECEDENT: fz-go4.18.28.2 (closed) fixed exactly this smell in PRODUCTION ("Transport sorts format types into display-string keys per comparison"). This ticket is the same defect in the test/gate layer. fz-kdt.17 (open) is the sibling for rendered closure identity.

THE FIX: a gate that means "this is the type" must ask the calculator -- `is_equiv` / mutual `is_subtype` against a constructed expectation Ty, or the structural comparator `types/order.rs cmp_tys` (which walks descriptor axes and is NOT a string compare). Keep a rendered string only where the DISPLAY ITSELF is the subject (types_test.rs`s display tests are legitimate). For the verdict pins, compare the ArrowMatch structurally: same discriminant, params/result pairwise `is_equiv`. Where the calculator cannot express the expectation, that gap IS the finding and gets its own ticket rather than a string.

NOT URGENT, NOT A MISCOMPILE: no production algorithm keys on a rendered type (TyCanon appears only in compiler2/canon.rs, telemetry/jsonl.rs and fixture_facts.rs -- artifact comparand and debugging, both sanctioned). This is instrument quality. Red-first: change a pinned type to a display-equal but distinct type (e.g. `list(int)` vs `non_empty_list(int)` at a collapsing position) and show the pin stays green at HEAD and goes red after the fix.

CONCORDANT: fz-kdt.48 (denotational Ty identity -- once mutually-subtype types intern to one ID, `is_equiv` becomes `==` and this gets cheaper), fz-go4.34, fz-go4.18.28.2, fz-kdt.17.
title: Gates assert types by their RENDERED string: pinned_verdicts and the frontier gate compare display() output, which is non-injective, so a pin can stay green while the type changes
